meta_description:
aditiraval on February 16, 2026: "A truly memorable and inspiring interaction with Hon’ble Dr. Hari Babu Kambhampati, Governor of Odisha. 

We spoke about Odisha’s culture, tourism, tribal life, local coffee, millet heritage, and even the idea behind EV vehicles in official convoys. 🚘

Listening to his experiences made me realise how powerful it is when a person works with vision, ethics, and purpose.
The beautiful gift he shared ☕️ tribal-grown coffee and heritage millets 🌾 carried the essence of Odisha’s people and traditions. 

It reminded me that to truly share culture and heritage with the world, one must live it and experience it deeply. His simplicity reflects how closely he connects with every part of the state.

My words feel small in appreciation of his journey. Grateful to Lord Jagannath for such meaningful experiences.

P.S Thank you Saurabh Khamar for explaining to me Odisha’s culture and stories in my mother tongue (Gujarati) whenever I asked during my visit. I’m truly grateful for your support and help. Our conversation took me back to my radio days😍તમારી નજરે ઓડિશા વિષે જાણીને આનંદ થયો.".
